verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-item agent tools: create_product, create_order, create_refund, accept_dispute_claim and single-cart create/get endpoints. List endpoints such as list_disputes are reads, not bulk writes. Store Sync and the partner catalog on-ramps make a catalog discoverable to agents, which is an adjacent feature rather than a user-facing capability to run one operation across many items at once. Batch or bulk endpoints are an applicable axis for a commerce API platform, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
